audit.why: Renekton level 1, skill at 2, Shen 3 through 5, Renekton at 6 on Dominus, Shen from first item on. Both layers agree row for row and match the packet chart; 49.19% over 1598 games supports the even 6/10 rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] gave Stand United a 180-second cooldown as if that were the number to track. It is 200/180/160, so 200 at rank 1.
audit.why: The whole level-6 spike is 'all-in while his R is gone' — the number decides how long that window lasts.
audit.corrected: Rank-1 figure stated, and the line reframed around the moment he sends it away.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (1) The page claims Spirit's Refuge makes your empowered W's 3-hit chain whiff. Riot's text says it blocks attacks; Ruthless Predator's slashes are ability damage, so what actually whiffs is your basic attacks and the W auto-reset. (2) Missing entirely: empowered W destroys damage shields on the target, and Shen's passive Ki Barrier is exactly that — a shield he refreshes off every spell cast.
audit.why: The first error tells the player to abort a combo that in fact lands; the second hides the reason banking 50 Fury matters more here than in most matchups.
audit.corrected: Spirit's Refuge restated as an attack-block (autos and the auto-reset wasted, slashes still land); Ki Barrier destruction stated in report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: mid told the player to track Spirit's Refuge 'at roughly 14 seconds'. It is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10, so 16s at rank 1.
audit.why: Trading on a two-second-early estimate walks you into the block.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns used for Spirit's Refuge (16s) and Shadow Dash (18s) throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 'Cull the Meek', 'Spirit's Refuge' and 'Shadow Dash' as probable wrong names.
audit.why: All three are false positives — Cull the Meek is Renekton's own Q, and the other two are Shen's real W and E.

edits.before: E-in before Spirit's Refuge is active gives you the clean empowered W stun; Shen's W is on a 14-second cooldown early and is rarely preloaded at level 2.
edits.after: E-in before Spirit's Refuge is up gives the clean empowered W stun; his W is 16s at rank 1 and 40 energy, so it is rarely preloaded this early at level 2.

edits.before: Spirit's Refuge is now a reliable trade deterrent — if he reads your engage and pops W, your empowered 3-hit stun's autos all whiff and the window closes.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge deters trades — it blocks attacks, so your autos and the W auto-reset are wasted inside it, though the slashes are spell damage and still land.

edits.before: E in, bank 50 Fury, land empowered W before Shen can activate Spirit's Refuge — his W only blocks autos so your stun still lands, but if he pops it first your 3-hit chain whiffs.
edits.after: E in, bank 50 Fury, land empowered W before Spirit's Refuge is up — 50 Fury also destroys the Ki Barrier shield outright, and the slashes ignore his block; only the autos you add inside it are wasted.

edits.before: Track Stand United's 180-second cooldown and all-in only when it is down or on long cooldown
edits.after: Track Stand United — 200s at rank 1 — and all-in the moment he sends it to another lane

edits.before: - Shen Shadow Dash: matchup-defining — His engage CC. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shen Shadow Dash: his engage taunt, 18s at rank 1 and 150 energy — dodge it, then commit. - Spirit's Refuge: 16s, and it blocks attacks only. - Empowered W destroys Ki Barrier. - Dominus: 120s, kill windows only.

edits.before: His engage CC. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His taunt, 18s at rank 1 — bait it, then the lane is yours.

edits.before: Track Shen's Shadow Dash (Taunt): His engage CC. Dodge it. When it is down — W-stun + Q him.
edits.after: Empowered W destroys shields, so 50 fury erases Ki Barrier. Shadow Dash is 18s: bait it, then burst.

edits.before: That is Shen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks — every auto inside it is damage handed back.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 Shen starts generating meaningful Ki Barrier shields between trades and his Spirit's Refuge comes up more often on cooldown, so your all-in windows narrow. Trade only when his W is visibly on cooldown — you can track it at roughly 14 seconds. At level 6 you get your best single window: Dominus stacks HP and accelerates Fury so you can chain two empowered Ws if the fight runs long, and unless Shen sent his R recently he cannot match that burst. The moment you see Stand United channel, stop everything and walk away — the support arriving turns a winning fight into a death sentence. If he burns his R before you hit 6, immediately shove and all-in; that is your free kill.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 Shen refreshes Ki Barrier off every cast and Spirit's Refuge comes up more often, so your windows narrow. Trade when his W is spent — it is 16s at rank 1 — and remember 50 Fury destroys the Ki Barrier shield rather than chipping through it. At level 6 you get your best single window: Dominus stacks HP and accelerates Fury so you can chain two empowered Ws if the fight runs long, and unless Shen sent his R recently he cannot match that burst. The moment you see Stand United channel, stop everything and walk away — the ally arriving turns a winning fight into a death. If he burns his R before you hit 6, shove and all-in; that is your free kill.

notes: Confidence is Medium on one point: Riot's Spirit's Refuge text blocks 'attacks', and Ruthless Predator's slashes are ability damage, so the existing claim that the whole 3-hit chain whiffs is very likely wrong — I restated it as autos and the auto-reset being wasted rather than asserting a hard rule the kit file does not spell out. Empowered W destroying Ki Barrier is directly in Renekton's own ability text and was absent from the whole page. Mirror shen__renekton not yet audited; no chart rows changed.
